items.title: Hyderabad: Govt land auction beside Durgam Cheruvu sparks row over heritage rock site
items.summary: Follow TNM's WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. The Telangana government’s call to auction 10.63 acres of prime real estate in Hyderabad’s IT corridor for a minimum of Rs 1,860 crore has triggered criticism as the plots lie right next to the Durgam Cheruvu lake. Critics have expressed concern that the land falls within the lake’s catchment area and is also close to heritage hillocks protected by the Hyderabad Urban Development Authority Zoning Regulations 1981. The e-auction of the two adjacent plots, part of the Raidurg Hyderabad Knowledge City, is scheduled for August 21 and 28, the Telangana State Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (TGIIC) has announced. The plots in survey no. 83/1 – 5.25 acres and 5.38 acres – fall under the Raidurg Panmaktha village of Serilingampally mandal. The TGIIC has set a minimum price of Rs 175 crore per acre for the auction.
